options.name: maxFileContentLength
options.label: Maximum Processing Length for File Content

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a local file and return it as a string. Always reads up to {config.maxFileContentLength} characters. Use the offset parameter to read different parts of large files.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The full path of the file to read. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional. Character offset to start reading from (default: 0). Use this to read different parts of large files. For example, offset {config.maxFileContentLength} reads characters {config.maxFileContentLength}-{config.maxFileContentLength*2}.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write the given content to a local file, creating or overwriting it.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The full path of the file to write to. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to write into the file.

tools.name: extract_file
tools.description: Extract an archive file using 7za.exe to a specified destination directory.

parameters.name: archive_path
parameters.description: The full path of the archive file to extract. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: The full path of the destination directory where files will be extracted. Directory will be created if it doesn't exist. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file from one location to another. Destination directory will be created if it doesn't exist.

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: The full path of the file to move. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: The full path where the file should be moved to. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file from one location to another. Destination directory will be created if it doesn't exist.

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: The full path of the file to copy. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: The full path where the file should be copied to. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the file system. Use with caution as this operation cannot be undone.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The full path of the file to delete. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List all files and subdirectories in a given directory.

parameters.name: directory_path
parameters.description: The full path of the directory to list. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.
